# Notebooks skipped by the CI test sweep (notebook-test-exclusions.txt) that
# ARE built and verified as container images anyway.
#
# The plain CI runner and the container image are different environments: the
# image ships system libraries (libgl1, libglib2.0-0, libxcb1, ...) that the
# runner lacks, so some notebooks that cannot run in the CI sweep run fine
# inside the image. Lines are fnmatch glob patterns, same as the exclusion
# lists. A notebook listed here must still pass in-image verification before
# its image is published.

# OpenCV import needs libxcb/libgl, which the image ships (Colab does too).
